      "code": "\n# Sample size calculation for proportion estimation with confidence interval\n# Using normal approximation: n = (z² × p × (1-p)) / E²\n\n# Parameters\np <- 0.70          # target proportion\nq <- 1 - p         # complement\nz <- 1.96          # exact standard normal 97.5th percentile (two-sided 95% CI)\nE <- 0.03          # half-width (margin of error)\n\n# Calculate sample size\nn_exact <- (z^2 * p * q) / E^2\n\n# Round upward\nn <- ceiling(n_exact)\n\n# Verify the calculation step-by-step\nz_squared <- z^2\nnumerator <- z_squared * p * q\ndenominator <- E^2\n\ncat(\"Sample Size Calculation for Proportion Estimation\\n\")\ncat(\"================================================\\n\")\ncat(\"Target proportion (p):\", p, \"\\n\")\ncat(\"Complement (q):\", q, \"\\n\")\ncat(\"Standard normal 97.5th percentile (z):\", z, \"\\n\")\ncat(\"Half-width / Margin of error (E):\", E, \"\\n\\n\")\n\ncat(\"Formula: n = (z² × p × q) / E²\\n\\n\")\n\ncat(\"Calculation steps:\\n\")\ncat(\"z² =\", z_squared, \"\\n\")\ncat(\"p × q =\", p * q, \"\\n\")\ncat(\"z² × p × q =\", numerator, \"\\n\")\ncat(\"E² =\", denominator, \"\\n\")\ncat(\"n (exact) = \", numerator, \"/\", denominator, \" =\", n_exact, \"\\n\")\ncat(\"n (rounded upward) =\", n, \"\\n\")\n\n# Return structured result\nresult <- data.frame(\n  metric = \"sample_size\",\n  value = n,\n  unit = \"participants_total\"\n)\n\ncat(\"\\n\\nFinal Result:\\n\")\nprint(result)\n\n# Output JSON\nlibrary(jsonlite)\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT <- jsonlite::toJSON(\n  list(results = list(\n    list(metric = \"sample_size\", value = n, unit = \"participants_total\")\n  )),\n  auto_unbox = TRUE,\n  digits = 15\n)\ncat(\"\\n\", POWER_AGENT_RESULT, \"\\n\")\n",
